messages.author: f71001a854831d44
messages.subject: Maxent Version 3.4.4
parts:
Hi Wallace Team,

I'm attempting to run some models on Wallace using the maxent.jar function, but an error message pops up on the program saying that I'm using maxent version 3.4.3, and that I need to update it to version 3.4.4. 

Do any of you guys know how to go about doing this? I've tried downloading the new version itself from the AMNH website for maxent onto my desktop, but it's still giving me that same error message. 

Thank you, and all the best!

Evan Miller

messages.author: 881c0dd9c7b0d196
messages.subject: Re: Maxent Version 3.4.4
parts:
Hi Evan,
Check out the README file on the Wallace github page- there is some helpful info there for troubleshooting this problem (the maxent.jar file needs to be in the /java directory of the `dismo` package root folder) but I would also recommend updating the `rJava` package. Hope that works!

messages.author: 881c0dd9c7b0d196
messages.subject: Re: Maxent Version 3.4.4
parts:
Using system.file('java', package="dismo") should return the path to the /java folder. Then copy and paste the maxent.jar file into the java directory.
If this isn't working, it might be a problem with permissions within the machine. You could try it using Finder instead of R, but if the problem is with permissions it won't work either way.
